div.h2: WHAT CAN WE DO FOR YOU?

div.p: Our professionals will perform thorough quality checks, prepare all the paperwork, pack, load and ship your tires.

div.class: wprt-icon-box clearfix has-width style-1 icon-top outline-type align-center rounded-100 w100 grey-outline

div.p: We will pack up to three used tyres in one. This way we are able to double the amount of used tyres fitting into a container.

div.class: wprt-icon-box clearfix has-width style-1 icon-top outline-type align-center rounded-100 w100 grey-outline

div.p: We can help, or if you want to, even manage the whole transportation of your used tyres from our warehouse to your desired destination.

div.class: wprt-icon-box clearfix has-width style-1 icon-top outline-type align-center rounded-100 w100 grey-outline

div.p: If you wish we and our partners will help you handle the customs formalities and clearance. We will also assist you if any problems should arise.

div.class: wprt-icon-box clearfix has-width style-1 icon-top outline-type align-center rounded-100 w100 grey-outline

div.p: Our expierenced workers will make sure to load the maximum amount of tyres possible into a minibus, truck or container.
